structured_output.what_is_happening: This token is one of about ten or more copies named "Memetically-Engineered Product" (m/ep), all launched within roughly 15 minutes. That pattern usually means a single X post set off a ticker war. The GeckoTerminal link points to x.com/CookedSupermann/status/2103771937893965880, but that page could not be fetched (HTTP 402). This copy (Meteora virtual curve, migrated to PumpSwap straight away) is currently the largest by market cap: about $98k market cap, $29k liquidity, $162k volume in 12 minutes, 1,513 unique buyers against 128 sellers, and price up about 86–174%. It is not the first launch. The 6mEf...pump copy was created 4 minutes earlier and has more hourly volume ($263k at a $57k market cap).

narrative.description: The name plays on the idea of 'memetic engineering'. The 'm/' prefix may copy a subforum-style naming format. The trigger is likely a tweet by CookedSupermann that I could not see. I found no news or wider cultural event behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: Probably one X post plus launchpad sniping and copycat deploys. Organic spread beyond that could not be verified.

token_connection.why_this_token: This copy has the highest market cap and liquidity of the clones, and it links the source tweet on GeckoTerminal.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 6mEf...pump launched earlier, has $263k hourly volume and $20k liquidity at a $57k market cap. 9Bro... has $27k liquidity. Many other copies are already dead with about $0 liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: The buyer count is large (1,513 unique buyers vs 128 sellers), but GMGN flags 96 bundler wallets, which is 7.35% of top-trader activity. There is no smart-money or KOL signal and no paid boosts. The web search turned up only the pump.fun listing for a copy.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see the X source post or how widely it spread. The very lopsided buyer-to-seller ratio may reflect bots or sniping.
